label: Tomato___healthy
description: The tomato foliage is vigorous, uniformly green, free from foliar lesions, bacterial spots, insect webs, or viral mottling.

label: Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot
description: A destructive fungal foliar disease caused by Septoria lycopersici, initiating on lower leaves as circular water-soaked spots with dark margins and gray centers.

label: Tomato___Bacterial_spot
description: Bacterial disease caused by Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria, characterized by small, greasy dark lesions with chlorotic halos, thriving in warm, rainy weather.

label: Tomato___Late_blight
description: A severe oomycete disease caused by Phytophthora infestans, causing rapidly expanding pale green to dark water-soaked greasy lesions, white mold beneath leaves, and rapid vine collapse.

label: Cabbage___healthy
description: The cabbage plant displays crisp, waxy, uniform green or purplish leaves with no V-shaped chlorosis or black vascular rings.

label: Tomato___Spider_mites
description: Pest damage caused by Tetranychus urticae feeding on cell sap under leaves, producing dense stippling, chlorotic bronzing, and delicate silk webbing.

label: Tomato___Leaf_Mold
description: Fungal infection caused by Passalora fulva (Cladosporium fulvum), causing pale yellow chlorotic patches on upper leaf surfaces and velvety olive-brown sporulation beneath.

label: Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus
description: A devastating begomovirus transmitted by the whitefly Bemisia tabaci, causing severe leaf curling, yellow interveinal chlorosis, bushiness, stunting, and flower abortion.

label: Soybean___Frogeye_Leaf_Spot
description: Fungal disease caused by Cercospora sojina, causing circular to angular eye-like spots with reddish-brown borders and ash-gray centers.

label: Soybean___Downy_Mildew
description: Foliar disease caused by Peronospora manshurica, producing yellowish speckles on upper leaf surfaces and fluffy gray-purple mycelium on corresponding leaf undersides.

label: Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_
description: Fungal disease caused by Puccinia sorghi, producing oval to elongate reddish-brown powdery pustules that rupture both leaf surfaces in cool, humid weather.

label: Corn_(maize)___healthy
description: Maize plants exhibit strong green leaf blades, sturdy stalks, and vigorous tassel/ear development without necrotic lesions or rust pustules.

label: Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_spot
description: A severe fungal disease caused by Cercospora zeae-maydis, forming narrow rectangular tan lesions strictly delimited by leaf veins.

label: Corn_(maize)___Lethal_Necrosis
description: A destructive viral disease caused by synergistic coinfection of Maize Chlorotic Mottle Virus (MCMV) with a potyvirus (SCMV), causing leaf margin necrosis and dead hearts.

label: Soybean___healthy
description: Soybean leaves show uniform rich green trifoliate foliage, strong nodulation, and healthy vegetative/pod development without spotting.

label: Cabbage___Black_Rot
description: A high-impact bacterial disease caused by Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris, showing distinctive V-shaped yellow lesions with blackened veins pointing towards leaf bases.
